text: The latest psychic powers of the population conjure up creative, mashing divinities and attempts for redemption. It's all just a shadow play, but the comfort is obvious as the eyeballs sizzle visibly. Some people just can't accept the truth, and I'll be blanking out of existence pretty soon. Life is a habit of tying up loose ends. I wish I'd seen the new dominant species rule, but time is all consuming. I'm assuming that my mind will be gone in a countdown of several seconds. Our era on earth is over. A new age is upon us.
